verdict.rationale: smolagents is a plain Python library/CLI (agent.run(), CLI tools smolagent/webagent) that can be scripted and executed non-interactively, and supports sandboxed execution backends (Docker, E2B, Modal, Blaxel) suitable for CI environments. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions) or documented automation/headless-mode guidance beyond generic script usage.
